noah: Quick heads-up: ran initial onboarding for marine-embed-7b (embedding-only head) comparing fp16 vs pt8 vs pc8 on semantic-suite-multilang v1 (30k queries). Short summary: pt8 gives good latency but causes a surprising bump in multilingual id-flips and a small recall@1 regression on short queries. Posting compact numbers + next steps.

amira: Can you paste the numbers and which splits?

noah: Eval split = semantic-suite-multilang v1 (en, es, zh, ar, pt). Seeds 3/7/13, median of 3 runs. Results: 
```
config      recall@1  recall@5  shortq@1(<7t)  idflip_k5  silhouette_k5
fp16        0.862     0.940     0.812           0.09%     0.418
pt8         0.853     0.935     0.780           0.54%     0.394
pc8         0.860     0.939     0.803           0.13%     0.412
```
notes: pt8 increases idflip notably, pc8 mostly recovers quality. Short-query hit smaller with pc8 but still ~-0.009 vs fp16.

sanjay: Where is the idflip concentrated by language?

noah: Breakdown (idflip_k5 pt8): en 0.21% -> pt8 0.48%; zh 0.12% -> 0.62%; ar 0.30% -> 1.12% (biggest); pt 0.07% -> 0.22%. So ar and zh take the worst hit.

amira: Could be calibration bias from token frequency during calib. Did you try IDF-weighted or per-lang calibration?

oah: Not yet. I checked token-norm shifts: ar-token norms drop ~2.9% with pt8, zh ~2.0%, en ~0.9%. Layer-wise drift points to final projection and attn_out blocks 10-12.

terry: Try two quick ablations: 1) per-channel int8; 2) per-channel + targeted clamp on proj_out 12 (clamp=0.92). Also run per-lang calibration with 2k samples/lang in calib set.

noah: Will do. Kicked off pc8 and pc8+clamp runs on dedicated-ml-1. Command I used for clamp test: 
```
rbw-quant --model marine-7b --mode pc8 --clamp-layers "proj_out:12" --clamp 0.92 --calib-samples 4096 --per-lang-calib true --out ./runs/marine/pc8_clamp/
```

sanjay: Also collect NN-stability (overlap top10) and bootstrap CI for idflip. If pc8+clamp brings ar idflip <0.25% and shortq delta <0.006, we can consider a small 3-day canary.

amira: Ops: reserve 3xA100 for 4h to run the per-lang calib + larger holdouts. @ops-bot

ops-bot: Reservation confirmed: dedicated-ml-1, 3xA100, window today 21:00-01:00 UTC. Job-id rbw-10021. Artifacts will be uploaded to /artifacts/rbw-10021/5105002468/. :white_check_mark:

noah: Thanks. Quick interim pc8+clamp results (median of 2 quick runs, warm but usable): 
```
pc8+clamp: recall@1 0.861, shortq@1 0.806, idflip_k5 (ar) 0.24%, overall idflip 0.11%, silhouette 0.415
```

noah: Promising - clamp + per-lang calib narrows ar gap a lot. Latency: p95 fp16 34ms -> pc8+clamp 28ms (~18% p95 win). Throughput +15%.

terry: Good. Next steps: 1) run full 50k short-query holdout (3 seeds) for stable CI; 2) run 5x 30k id-flip fuzz samples to stabilize idflip estimate; 3) generate UMAP diffs for ar/zh head/tail clusters and per-layer drift table. If gates pass (ar idflip <0.25%, shortq delta <0.006, silhouette drop <0.01) -> plan 3-day 5% staging canary with alerts.

amira: Add human spot-check (2k ar queries) for semantic relevance of top3 neighbors. If human precision drop >1pp, abort.

noah: Queued the jobs under rbw-10021 and will upload artifacts to the path above. TL;DR: pt8 fast but noisy for low-resource langs; pc8 + targeted clamp + per-lang calibration looks promising. Will post full numbers and UMAPs after the dedicated runs. :mag:
